name: kb_tall_skinny_matmul_m_much_greater_n
description: Tall-skinny matrix multiplication where M >> N. This pattern benefits from split-K or stream-K optimizations to parallelize across the tall dimension. Input A is shape (M, K), B is shape (K, N), output is (M, N).

M.description: Number of rows in A (much larger than N)

K.description: Inner dimension (columns of A, rows of B)

N.description: Number of columns in B (much smaller than M)

name: kb_tall_skinny_matmul_n_much_greater_m
description: Tall-skinny matrix multiplication where N >> M (transpose variant). Input A is shape (K, M), B is shape (N, K), output is (N, M). This is the transposed version where the second matrix is tall.

M.description: Number of columns in A (much smaller than N)

K.description: Inner dimension (rows of A, columns of B)

N.description: Number of rows in B (much larger than M)
